schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-xpath-evaluate-inputsource-xxe
title: XPath evaluate() on an InputSource parses XML with an unhardened parser (XXE)
summary: 'Calling XPath.evaluate(expression, InputSource, returnType) (or the two-argument form) makes
  the JAXP implementation parse the XML with its own default, non-hardened parser. External entities and
  DTDs are then resolved, which allows XXE: file disclosure, SSRF and denial of service. The fix parses
  the InputSource first with a securely configured DocumentBuilderFactory and evaluates the XPath on the
  resulting DOM.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-611
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: eb8d66c0995d1e1dd5bfcfb657c8c9de21266d97
  vulnerable_ref: eb8d66c0995d1e1dd5bfcfb657c8c9de21266d97^
  patched_ref: eb8d66c0995d1e1dd5bfcfb657c8c9de21266d97
  repository: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ws
rule:
  message: 'XPath evaluate() is called directly on an InputSource, so the XML is parsed by the default
    JAXP parser with external entities enabled. Parse the input with a hardened DocumentBuilderFactory
    (DTDs and external entities disabled) and evaluate the XPath on the resulting Document.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: $XPATH.evaluate($EXPR, $SRC, $TYPE)
    - pattern: $XPATH.evaluate($EXPR, $SRC)
    - pattern: $XPATH.compile($EXPR).evaluate($SRC, $TYPE)
    - pattern: $XPATH.compile($EXPR).evaluate($SRC)
  - metavariable-pattern:
      metavariable: $SRC
      patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: new InputSource(...)
        - pattern: (InputSource $X)
        - pattern: $INPUTSOURCE
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern-inside: "$RET $METHOD(..., InputSource $SRC, ...) {\n  ...\n}\n"
    - pattern-inside: "$RET $METHOD(..., InputSource $SRC2, ...) {\n  ...\n}\n"
    - pattern: $XPATH.evaluate($EXPR, new InputSource(...), ...)
fix:
  guidance: Do not hand an InputSource to XPath.evaluate. Build the DocumentBuilderFactory through the
    project's hardened helper (DocumentBuilderFactoryUtils.newInstance(), which disables DTDs and external
    entities), parse the InputSource into a Document, and evaluate the XPath against that Document. For
    SAX sources, run the source through the hardened transformer helper and evaluate on the resulting
    DOM.
  example: 'DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactoryUtils.newInstance();

    factory.setNamespaceAware(true);

    Document document = factory.newDocumentBuilder().parse(inputSource);

    Object result = xpath.evaluate(expression, document, returnType);

    '
